entities.summary: Frederic Desire Ehui , best known as Meiway, is a singer from the Ivory Coast. He is most notable for pioneering the Zoblazo style. His hits include "200% Zoblazo", "Godeba", "Appolo 95", "Miss Lolo", and "DJ Tassouman".
